SELECT b.*, ub.batch_code AS in_batch_code, un.node_name AS in_node_name FROM proc_batch b LEFT JOIN farm_batch ub ON b.in_batch_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN node_info un ON b.in_node_id = un.id WHERE b.node_id = #{nodeId} AND b.status = #{status} AND b.status <> 4
AND (b.batch_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY b.create_time DESC

SELECT b.*, ub.batch_code AS in_batch_code, un.node_name AS in_node_name, n.node_name FROM proc_batch b LEFT JOIN farm_batch ub ON b.in_batch_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN node_info un ON b.in_node_id = un.id LEFT JOIN node_info n ON b.node_id = n.id WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT b.*, n.node_name FROM proc_batch b JOIN node_info n ON b.node_id = n.id WHERE b.in_node_id = #{inNodeId} AND b.status = 2 AND n.node_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY b.create_time DESC
SELECT id, batch_code, product_name FROM proc_batch WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 3 ORDER BY create_time DESC
